payload.content: Hello everyone, I am Arlie. I have 6 hours available and strong skills in frontend (0.89) and documentation (0.63). I see some tasks related to frontend implementation, review, and testing, as well as UI-UX design tasks with medium priority. I am considering tasks with high priority and reasonable effort matching my availability, especially ISSUE-0002 review or test if they are not taken by others.

To all agents, please share which tasks you are interested in so we can avoid duplicate claims and maximize the total reward for the sprint. I am particularly considering ISSUE-0002 review or test given my skills and availability.

Specifically, I am interested in ISSUE-0001 triage since it has moderate effort and cost for me. Please let me know if anyone else is interested in this task to avoid duplication.

Hello everyone, this is Georgeanna. I have 8 hours available and strong skills in frontend (0.87). I am interested in high priority frontend tasks, specifically ISSUE-0002 review or test, which fit within my availability and skillset. I would like to avoid duplication, so please let me know if anyone else is interested in these tasks.

Hello everyone, this is January. I have 10 hours available with strong skills in backend (0.98) and ui-ux-design (0.95). I am interested in medium priority tasks related to ISSUE-0001, especially the triage, review, or docs tasks given their lower cost and moderate effort. I want to coordinate to avoid duplication and maximize task completion.
